preconditions.description: The length of the input string S must be between 1 and 1000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in string.ascii_letters for c in S)
preconditions.description: The input string S must consist only of alphabetic characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-empty string.
The output must be a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout in S[i:] for i in range(len(S)))
postconditions.description: The output must be a substring of the input string S.
